name: Terminal Quote Grid
tags: bloomberg terminal amber monospace grid flash tick dense
note: Amber-on-black monospace grid where each tick repaints a single cell and flashes it, using a class swapped off on animationend rather than a timer.

name: Function Key Bar
note: Bloomberg amber function-key bar. Click or arrow-key between F1-F8; the selected key inverts with a two-beat flash and the status line types the function name out character by character. Clock is live.
html:
BLP FUNCTION KEYS 14:32:07
> HELP DESK 24H ONLINE

name: Command Line Autocomplete
note: Live command line with inline ghost completion and a filtered mnemonic list. Type to filter, arrow keys to move the pick, Tab to fill, Enter to execute; matches stagger in and the hit counter updates. Ruled empty rows keep the list block steady.
html:
CMD AAPL US EQUITY 04 HITS
> GP <GO>
TABfill ↑↓pick 12ms

name: Split Pane Monitor
note: Two-pane terminal layout with a draggable hairline divider — pointer drag, or focus the separator and use the arrow keys. Picking a contract on the left redraws the right-hand path with a stroke-dash draw-on and flips the pane red for a decline.
html:
MON SPLIT VIEW · GP CME
ESU61D · 5M
5482.25▲ +23.00

name: Keyboard Hint Strip
note: Green-screen shortcut strip that answers real key presses: focus the panel and hit ESC, ENTER, slash, TAB, F1 or BACKSPACE to strike the matching chip and bump the keystroke counter. Left idle it demos itself chip by chip.
html:
KEY MAP IDLE - DEMO
ESCCANCEL
↵<GO>
/SEARCH
TABNEXT PANE
F1HELP
⌫CLEAR LINE
KEYSTROKES 0000

name: Terminal Status Bar
note: Bottom-of-screen terminal telemetry: pulsing LIVE block, latency that jitters with a direction arrow and shifts green/amber/red, message rate, day P/L, and a 20-segment feed-load meter whose top segments run hot. Session and wall clocks both tick.
html:
LIVE SESSION 04:11:52 WBT-4021
LATENCY▼ 18ms
MSG/SEC1,284
DAY P/L▲ +8,420
FEED A · NY4 QUEUE 000 14:32:07 EST

name: Headline Crawl
note: News tape: a rotating priority headline that wipes in over a seamless price crawl (the sequence is cloned in JS so the loop never seams). The tape pauses on hover and on keyboard focus, and a real pause button stops the motion outright.
html:
TOP<GO> BN · 14:32 EST
■ FED HOLDS RATES, SIGNALS TWO CUTS IN 2026

name: Function Launchpad
note: Eight-tile function launcher. Click or tab to a tile and it fires: a scan line sweeps across it, the mini bar chart re-springs one bar at a time, the command bar wipes a progress fill and the status line types the mnemonic out.
html:
LAUNCHPAD 08 FUNCTIONS
> SELECT A FUNCTION
